limitations: This independent retention audit downloads only signed descriptors, reports and registry configuration metadata. Native image transport archives and registry filesystem layers are not downloaded locally; protected native verification and public digest-pull jobs execute those images.
SDK license metadata preserves the original MIT license plus aggregate third-party notices; Debian/system packages retain their own licenses.
payloadPolicy: Existing qualified SDK archive bytes are preserved; only downstream image packaging and metadata change.
reportEncoding: JSON sort_keys=True, indent=2, UTF-8 and final LF; re-encoding rawReport recovers its exact original bytes
